name: Pennsylvania Outdoor Corps, Youth Summer Program
org: Pennsylvania Department of Conservation and Natural Resources, with the Student Conservation Association
city: Pennsylvania (crews in 18 cities, including Philadelphia and Pittsburgh)
what_you_do: Join a small crew in state parks and forests for six weeks. You build trails, protect habitats and improve park spaces, with adult mentors.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18 at the start of the program. High school students. Crews are based in cities across Pennsylvania.
pay_detail: $17.31 per hour (2026). Lunch, safety gear and daily transport from a central meeting spot in your city are provided.
duration: 6 weeks, Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. (2026: June 29 to August 7)
deadline_text: 2026 dates were June 29 to August 7, 2026. No 2027 dates or deadline are posted on the page read.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Student Conservation Association (SCA) website. The state page links to the current openings. It links to the application too. You can email paoutdoorcorps@thesca.org.
notes: Crew locations change by year; check the SCA page for this year's list. Paid work for people under 18 in Pennsylvania needs a work permit. See permit.html?state=pa for the exact permit and steps.
